description:
Folkso finds real people for a task right in the conversation. Describe who you need for a job, a paid project, a startup team, a passion project, learning or meeting up in your city, and ChatGPT shows matching people as cards.

Everyone in the results created a Folkso profile and chose to appear in AI answers. A card shows what the person does, availability, city and rate. Open a profile to see their work and why they fit your task.

To contact someone, ChatGPT drafts a short request and shows you a preview. It is sent only after you confirm. Contacts never reach the model. You and the person swap contacts only after they accept.

You can also check whether someone replied, cancel a request, and keep your own profile status up to date.

defaultPrompt: Find a React developer in Europe for a contract up to $6,000 a month
Find a product designer for my budgeting app and draft a message to the best match
Help me create my Folkso profile. I'm a UX designer in Lisbon, $60 an hour
